definition: Transcript annotation, a missing translation, an NMD biotype, or an identical pair of translations.
Two protein-coding GENCODE v34 translations differ, and no supported functional-region difference is called.
A Level 1 sequence difference plus a supported Pfam, signal-peptide, or transmembrane difference on version-matched coordinates.
An isoform-specific peptide or other protein identification distinguishes the isoform. Gene-level abundance does not qualify.
